newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mostly lower in quiet AM trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mostly lower in quiet AM trade.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was mostly lower in morning trade, but volume was poor, traders said.
"There's nothing happening. People are just sitting back and waiting for a move," one trader said.
Market players were looking to New York for a signal of the next direction, he said.
Thursday's fall had "confused a lot of people," he said.

By 1017 GMT front month October was 50 cents lower on $320.50, with 27 lots done of a total 280. March and August were most active, with 125 lots each. March was 10 cents lower at $318.90, while August was 20 cents lower at $314.40.
